marathon county so.name: Marathon County Sheriff's Office
marathon county so.note: Publishes a transparency portal, linked from the county's own website; current figures are in the stat grid above. Shares its data with more than 1,400 agencies in 40 states, including the FBI and two HIDTA task forces. The office joined ICE's 287(g) jail-enforcement program in late 2025; UW-Madison police said in July 2026 it was cutting Flock access for 287(g) agencies, and Marathon County still appeared on its sharing list at the time.
